threshold_rule.trigger: Adjacent main COST cells switch a downstream coordinate between impossible and required in optimal set
threshold_rule.scan: For each ratio axis choose first qualifying edge ordered by fixed-other ratio then ascending axis
threshold_rule.design: Evaluate all three quarter subdivisions of that edge, and +/- half component-budget unit at both endpoints
threshold_rule.classification: Local discrete brackets only. Compare to +/-1/2 budget; no monotonicity or universal breakpoint assumed.

assembly_rule: Complete grid outputs remain visible, including failures and all optimal range witnesses
